summary_rationale: Steel Strips Wheels Limited (SSWL) is a well-managed, market-leading industrial wheel manufacturer (~54% M&HCV steel wheel share, ~42% tractor share, ~32%+ alloy revenue mix) that has successfully pivoted into higher-margin LPDC alloy wheels, aluminium steering knuckles, and US/EU exports while eliminating all promoter pledges (0% vs. 50-57% in 2019) and delivering record Q2 FY27 revenue (₹1,930 Cr, +61% YoY) at a 12.2% EBITDA margin. However, it is a capital-intensive, cyclical OEM supplier rather than an asset-light compounder: pre-tax ROCE moderated from 21% (FY23) to 14.8% (latest) with ROE at 11.0%, net adjusted leverage (including LC acceptances) remained above 2.5x through FY24-FY26 per Ind-Ra, borrowings ticked up to ₹914 Cr in Sep 2026, and the October 2026 ₹1,400 Cr Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar greenfield capex launches a fresh 60-month capital cycle. Business quality is therefore CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with KPI health PASS_WITH_WATCH.
